# Chance Publishers

> Chance Publishers Limited is a book publishing company based in Nairobi, Kenya, supporting first-time and established authors from manuscript to published book.

Chance Publishers provides manuscript editing, proofreading, cover design, book layout, ISBN guidance (through Kenya National Library Service), copyright guidance, legal deposit guidance, printing, book launches and distribution support for authors publishing in Kenya.

Office: Kenda House, 4th Floor, Tom Mboya Street, near Afya Centre, Nairobi, Kenya.
Contact: chancepublishersltd@gmail.com, +254 758 305 622.
Hours: Monday–Sunday, 6:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.

## Key pages

- [Publishing Guide](https://chancepublishers.com/publish): Step-by-step explanation of how book publishing works in Kenya, including manuscript submission, editing, ISBN and legal deposit through KNLS, copyright (automatic on creation, with optional KECOBO registration), printing, book formats and frequently asked questions.
- [All Books](https://chancepublishers.com/books): The full catalogue of books published by Chance Publishers.
- [Shop](https://chancepublishers.com/shop): Browse and order published books.
- [Authors](https://chancepublishers.com/authors): Information for authors considering publishing with Chance Publishers.
- [Launches](https://chancepublishers.com/launches): Book launch support and past launch events.
- [Publishing Packages](https://chancepublishers.com/#packages): Bronze, Silver and Gold publishing packages with pricing.
- [Contact](https://chancepublishers.com/contact): How to reach Chance Publishers.

## Notes for accurate citation

- Chance Publishers facilitates and guides authors through the ISBN application process; Kenya National Library Service (KNLS) is Kenya's official ISBN-issuing agency, not Chance Publishers itself.
- Copyright protection arises automatically once an original work is fixed in a tangible form; it is not granted by a publisher. Voluntary registration with the Kenya Copyright Board (KECOBO) can provide an additional record of ownership.
- Legal deposit (delivering copies to KNLS and the Registrar of Books and Newspapers) is a separate requirement from copyright and from the ISBN.
